budget-2026-energy-bills.title: Analysis of the Autumn Budget 2026 energy bill measures
budget-2026-energy-bills.description: PolicyEngine estimates the £100 Household Energy Payment and the zero rate of VAT on domestic electricity cost £2.81 billion in 2026-27 and raise household net income by an average of £96.

carers-allowance-taper.title: The Carer's Allowance earnings taper in the Autumn Budget 2026
carers-allowance-taper.description: From some point in 2030-31, the Carer's Allowance taper lets carers in England and Wales whose net earnings exceed the Weekly Earnings Limit keep part of the allowance, instead of losing all of it. We show how the limit (a projected £234 a week in 2031-32) and its £1-for-£1 taper work, and how they pass through to income tax and Universal Credit.

fuel-duty-cut-extension.title: The fuel duty cut extension in the Autumn Budget 2026
fuel-duty-cut-extension.description: The Budget keeps fuel duty at 52.95p a litre to 30 June 2027. We show how the duty and VAT on each litre change, and what this means for households by the fuel they use.

pension-tax-allowance.title: The Pension Tax Allowance in the Autumn Budget 2026
pension-tax-allowance.description: From April 2027, the Pension Tax Allowance removes income tax for most pensioners with total income up to the full new State Pension. We show how the £94 allowance and its £1-in-£3 taper work, and how they pass through to Pension Credit, Housing Benefit and Council Tax Reduction.

uk-autumn-budget-2026-property-income-ta.title: Autumn Budget 2026: higher tax on property income
uk-autumn-budget-2026-property-income-ta.description: Worked examples of the additional two percentage point property income tax increase from April 2027, including landlords' mortgage-interest relief and the treatment of Scotland.

uk-autumn-budget-2026-trading-allowance.title: Autumn Budget 2026: raising the trading allowance
uk-autumn-budget-2026-trading-allowance.description: The trading allowance rises from £1,000 to £3,000. We show how receipts and actual expenses determine the income tax reduction.

uk-triple-lock-budget-2026.title: The adjusted Triple Lock in the Autumn Budget 2026
uk-triple-lock-budget-2026.description: From April 2030, the State Pension rises by the higher of inflation and 2.5%, or by more where needed to hold its April 2029 value relative to earnings. We explain how the Triple Lock works and what the adjusted rule saves: on our pre-Budget estimates, £0.9 billion in 2039-40 on the OBR's March 2026 central path and £10.3 billion if the Triple Lock outpaces earnings as the OBR assumes.
